annotations.title: Get Superset pricing for a coach

description: Get the cheapest Superset plan for a coach with this many clients, with its monthly and yearly cost. Base takes 4% of client payments; Pro takes a flat 1.00 USD and Business 0.50 USD per sale. Pass monthly_client_payments and monthly_client_sales to count those fees.

monthly_client_payments.description: Optional. USD clients pay the coach each month

monthly_client_sales.description: Optional. Client payments the coach takes each month

takes_payments.description: Whether clients pay the coach through Superset
